page_title: LIL 0-2 REN | Lille v Rennes 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' A substitution has been made. Mousa Tamari goes off and Elias Legendre (Rennes) comes on.
90+1' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Rennes was in an offside position.
90+1' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
86' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) sends an accurate short pass. Valentin Rongier controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Osame Sahraoui (Lille) for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
83' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
82' Lille get a corner.
81' Felix Correia (Lille) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
80' Thomas Meunier (Lille) and Benjamin Andre matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
75' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
75' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Berke Ozer sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
75' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rennes.
74' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Calvin Verdonk will be replaced by Tiago Santos (Lille).
73' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
73' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Olivier Giroud trots off the pitch and is replaced by Soriba Diaoune (Lille).
70' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Marius Broholm and he is replaced by Felix Correia (Lille).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathias Fernandez-Pardo leaves the pitch and Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) comes on.
68' Breel Embolo (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
67' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:3.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) replaces Mohamed Meite.
62' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ludovic Blas (Rennes) replacing Quentin Merlin.
60' The linesman points to the corner flag, Lille are going to take it.
56' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Breel Embolo plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Quentin Merlin (Rennes). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 0:2.
56' The linesman makes the right call and Lille will have a corner.
56' Benjamin Andre (Lille) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
55' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rennes.
52' Calvin Verdonk (Lille) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
49' 0 - 1 Goal! Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) makes the score 0:1 after burying a close-range header in the bottom left corner after a good run and cross by Lilian Brassier.
46' Lille have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' A snap shot by Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Brice Samba produces a good save to thwart him.
45+2' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
41' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Brice Samba.
40' 0:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
36' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
33' The opposition back off Thomas Meunier (Lille) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
30' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
29' Mohamed Meite (Rennes) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the right post.

27' What a poor attempt! Olivier Giroud (Lille) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
25' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) swings in a cross from the corner, but Berke Ozer reads it well and gathers the ball.
21' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
20' The ball possession at the moment is 44:56.
16' The resulting corner from Quentin Merlin (Rennes) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
16' Rennes are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
14' Benjamin Andre (Lille) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
14' Alexsandro (Lille) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
10' A crossfield pass from Calvin Verdonk (Lille) fails to find any of his teammates.
6' Breel Embolo (Rennes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Eric Wattellier signals.
3' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' The corner from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) is intercepted by the defence.
2' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Rennes can continue in their attacking effort.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Rennes will take the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
